title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30173: add integration events to Sales Line Discounts page
summary: Two integration events are added to the Sales Line Discounts page to allow extensions to customize record filtering and resolve filter descriptions for item type values without modifying base code.
key_points: OnSetRecFiltersOnBeforeCurrPageUpdate event enables subscribers to apply additional filtering with access to the record and filter context
OnGetFilterDescriptionCaseElse event lets subscribers supply custom source tables and item filtering for unsupported item type values
Both events use the page's ItemTypeFilter option type for parameters
Events follow existing patterns on the page with IncludeSender set to true
Extensibility request addresses partner needs for building extensions on this page
